name: Final Prayer makes Prayer of Elune dispel one additional effect (#863)
contract: Final Prayer 704745 (SpellFamilyName 32) reads "Your Prayer of Elune now dispels $s1 additional effect". Its effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 12 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT2, EffectBasePoints 0 with DieSides 1 resolving to +1, and EffectSpellClassMask word1 0x1000, which is the SpellFamilyFlags word1 of every Prayer of Elune rank (801987 rank 1, 502348..502351, 575334 rank 6; SpellFamilyName 32). Prayer's effect index 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL (38) with EffectMiscValue 1 (Magic), DieSides 1 and EffectBasePoints 0, so its base amount is 1. Native path: SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue passes effect index 1 to Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers, which applies SPELLMOD_EFFECT2, and Spell::EffectDispel loops for count < damage, so the dispel count is the resolved value. The metric spell_effect_value with effect 1 returns exactly that CalcValue(player), so control must read 1 and the talented fixture 2, on the lowest and the highest rank. The module's coefficient rows for Prayer in AscensionStarcallerData.h are effect 0 only, and ModifySpellEffectBaseValue matches on the effect index, so effect 1 is untouched. Effect 1 of the passive (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 on mask word2 0x80000) is a leftover selecting only Star Pupil 680821, and is not a tooltip clause. Both fixtures are the same race, class and level.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Rank 1 Prayer of Elune dispels one effect without the talent
Rank 1 Prayer of Elune dispels two effects with the talent
Rank 6 Prayer of Elune dispels one effect without the talent
Rank 6 Prayer of Elune dispels two effects with the talent
